It is a matter of profound spiritual gravity to sit with the "unsearchable riches" of Christ while witnessing the "noise and tumult" of a world where rulers seek to "exalt themselves above the assembly of the LORD," and I must ask you with a gentle heart: why do you ask after the nature of occult influence in political power and the spiritual architecture of these regimes in this hour? [3, 1073, 1503, 1605, Conversation History]. Are you perhaps feeling "overwhelmed and desperate" by the sight of "savage wolves" who "malign" the truth and "demand things of God" that He has not granted them, or are you seeking a "settled certainty" to anchor your soul in the truth that the Master “sovereignly orders everything He has made”—including the rise and fall of "most formidable" empires? [13, 20, 922, 1143, 1285, 1408, 1605, Conversation History]. In a day when many “shave off the edges” of the truth to find "diplomatic relations" with an "anti-Christian agenda," we must return to the “external Word” to see how the Lord personally governs the "vicissitudes of life" by exposing the "spirit of fraud" in every human kingdom [11, 12, 28, 426, 1301, 1503, 1605, Conversation History].

The Reformed tradition teaches that “God personally and exhaustively pervades and sustains and governs every aspect of His creation,” and therefore, the existence of a ruler who seeks counsel from the darkness is not an “administrative anomaly” but is subject to the “decree from God” who "works all things according to the counsel of His will" (Ephesians 1:11) [15, 68, 161, 223, 723, 1143, 1532, 1563, 1720, Conversation History].

***

### **Section 1: The Biblical Prohibition of the Occult**

**Verse**
“ ‘When you come into the land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not learn to follow the abominations of those nations. There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, or one who practices witchcraft, or a soothsayer, or one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer, or one who conjures spells, or a medium, or a spiritist, or one who calls up the dead. For all who do these things are an abomination to the LORD, and because of these abominations the LORD your God drives them out from before you. You shall be blameless before the LORD your God’ ” (Deuteronomy 18:9–13). [833–834, 1150, 1152, Conversation History].

**Meaning**
The Scripture reveals that the "most determined enemies" of the Truth often employ "secret arts" and "witchcraft" to simulate power, yet these are "forbidden forms of witchcraft which involved demonic activity" [797, 1346, 1426, 1504, 1526, Conversation History]. Those who seek revelation through "mediums" and "spiritists" are in fact communicating with "spirits of the dead, who are actually impersonated by demons" [1428, 1429, Conversation History]. To practice such "abominations" is to "provoke Him to anger" and "exchange the truth of God for the lie" (Romans 1:25) [811, 889, 1427, Conversation History]. The Reformed tradition—echoed by **John MacArthur**—asserts that God "hates those who misrepresent His Word" through "lying divination" (Ezekiel 13:8–9) [81, 612, 1307, Conversation History].

**Takeaway**
You should “not look for some other fountain of knowledge” in the "vain imaginings" of those who claim "direct revelation" from the darkness, for “the Bible is the source of truth” and is "totally sufficient for your needs" (2 Timothy 3:16–17) [51, 91, 123, 456, 1312, 1381, 1461, 1503, Conversation History]. Recognize that “he who trusts in his own heart is a fool,” and you must instead "tremble at My word" (Isaiah 66:2; Proverbs 28:26) [1072, 1313, 1381, 1503, Conversation History].

**Advanced Note: Jewish vs. Gentile Context**
In the ancient **Jewish context**, these laws were "theocratic standards" meant to "purge the evil from your midst" and prevent the Israelites from "learning to follow the abominations" of the Canaanites [60, 828, 831, 833, 1314, Conversation History]. The New Testament **revises** our "spiritual service of worship," showing that while we "do not wrestle against flesh and blood," we use "the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" to "cast down arguments and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God" (Ephesians 6:12, 17; 2 Corinthians 10:5) [980, 1081, 1082, 1235, 1406, 1482, 1515, 1623, Conversation History].

***

### **Section 2: Occultism and Tyrants (Egypt and Babylon)**

**Verse**
“ ‘But Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers; so the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments. For every man threw down his rod, and they became serpents. But Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods’ ” (Exodus 7:11–12). [781, 1345, Conversation History].

**Meaning**
The “record of history” shows that tyrants frequently surround themselves with "learned men" and "magicians" who use "evil supernaturalism" or "sleight of hand" to "fool" those in power [781, 1346, 1349, 1508, Conversation History]. In regimes like Egypt and Babylon, "magic and sorcery played a major role," as rulers like Nebuchadnezzar "had his spirit so troubled that his sleep left him" and sought answers from "astrologers" and "sorcerers" (Daniel 2:1–2) [781, 1047, 1048, 1345, Conversation History]. However, their power is "powerless" before God, as they "could not stand" before the Lord's spokesmen and were forced to admit, " ‘This is the finger of God’ ” (Exodus 8:19; 9:11) [1334, 1349, 1350, Conversation History]. God “harnesses the deeds of the wicked” to prove that "nothing thwarts any aspect of His plan," even when the "nations rage" (Psalm 2:1) [5, 21, 64, 1132, 1419, 1429, 1515, 1564, 1572, 1616, Conversation History].

**Takeaway**
“Trade in your worry for trust,” for the "Spirit of God" is the only true power that can "utter God’s word accurately" and "undo" the work of Satan (Numbers 24:2) [31, 809, 1408, 1515, 1572, Conversation History]. You should "not be terrified" by the "furious rage" of a ruler who "disdains the Master," for "the LORD your God, the great and awesome God, is among you" (Deuteronomy 7:21) [1, 236, 819, 1110, 1143, 1487, 1502, 1532, Conversation History].

**Advanced Note: Forensic and Providential standing**
Under the **Mosaic economy**, "man-made representations" were "incinerated" as "strange fire" because they attempted to limit God to a physical form [216, 315, 318, 1133, 1322, 1344, 1375, Conversation History]. The New Testament **revises** our view by revealing that "the Word of God is not chained" and His rule is “mediated... solely and only by His revealed truth,” ensuring that we "do not become idolaters" like those who "sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play" (2 Timothy 2:9; 1 Corinthians 10:7) [25, 788, 1136, 1142, 1313, 1316, 1378, 1420, 1529, 1646, 1720, Conversation History].

***

### **Section 3: The Spiritual Architecture of State Religion**

**Verse**
“ ‘And they said, “Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top is in the heavens; let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad over the face of the whole earth” ’ ” (Genesis 11:4). [465, 788, 924, 1042, 1226, 1233, Conversation History].

**Meaning**
The Reformed tradition—echoed by **Voddie Baucham**—notes that "the system that is openly opposed to all that God is" often builds "monuments to their pride" to "make a name" for the regime [1233, 1288, 1315, 1665, Conversation History]. This "human pride" drives rulers to "defy God" through "building enterprises" and "royal dwelling[s]" where they "sit as God in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God" (2 Thessalonians 2:4; Daniel 4:30) [759, 789, 872, 882, 925, 1044, 1058, 1233, 1266, 1268, 1506, Conversation History]. Regimes that replace Christianity with state religion are often "insane with their idols" and "profess to know God, but in works they deny Him" (Titus 1:16; Jeremiah 50:38) [322, 614, 1046, 1381, 1407, 1415, 1441, 1468, 1507, 1508, 1551, 1572, 1574, Conversation History]. They use their "national greatness" as a "platform from which they look down on others," effectively "stealing the mind of Christ away from the body of Christ" [125, 172, 281, 1045, 1130, 1213, 1214, Conversation History].

**Takeaway**
“Never become so involved in this world” that you seek “deliverance” from a “despot” or an "earthly monarch," for “your life is not your own” because you were “bought at a price” (1 Corinthians 6:19–20; Psalm 62:2) [12, 20, 51, 101, 130, 192, 212, 856, 1020, 1138, 1262, 1406, 1503, 1623, 1670, Conversation History]. Your “sole objective” is to “adorn the doctrine of God” and "abstain from every form of evil," recognizing that "the form of this world is passing away" (1 Thessalonians 5:22; 1 Corinthians 7:31) [11, 13, 101, 125, 127, 295, 1406, 1434, 1617, 1670, 1684, Conversation History].

**Advanced Note: Civil vs. Spiritual Jurisdiction**
In the ancient **theocratic context**, God "removed kings from their thrones" when they "rejected the word of the LORD" to follow their own "ridiculous conceits" (1 Samuel 15:23) [7, 15, 17, 817, 858, 1078, 1183, 1533, Conversation History]. The New Testament **revises** our "citizenship," showing that we are "sojourners and pilgrims" looking for a "city whose builder and maker is God," for "Jesus answered, ‘My kingdom is not of this world’ ” (John 18:36; Hebrews 11:10; 1 Peter 1:17) [13, 20, 26, 38, 142, 440, 1255, 1313, 1320, 1321, 1426, 1529, Conversation History].

***

### **Section 4: The Final Verdict on Tyrannical Power**

**Verse**
“ ‘God has numbered your kingdom and put an end to it.… You have been weighed on the scales and found deficient.… Your kingdom has been divided’ ” (Daniel 5:26–28). [21, 37, 1061, 1402, 1720, Conversation History].

**Meaning**
The biblical authors resolve the "noise and tumult" of "idolatrous" regimes by fixating on the "consummation of history," where “Christ ultimately crushes the kingdoms of men and establishes His own” [13, 16, 20, 24, 31, 103, 136, 1199, 1315, 1515, 1720, Conversation History]. Every "storage city" and "monument of pride" will "vanish—like smoke they vanish away" (Psalm 102:3) [11, 32, 35, 37, 63, 789, 976, 1233, 1460, 1684, Conversation History]. Because the "Father gave this supreme authority to His Son," the "church militant" is an “assembly of the citizens of heaven” who wait for the Day when “the kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord and of His Christ” (Revelation 11:15; Ephesians 1:20–22) [13, 26, 30, 31, 158, 360, 361, 380, 1132, 1143, 1199, 1313, 1315, 1426, 1445, 1503, 1524, 1525, 1636, Conversation History].

**Takeaway**
“Wait for His Son from heaven,” knowing that “perfect justice will come” and he will “wipe away every tear from their eyes” (1 Thessalonians 1:10; Revelation 21:4) [14, 24, 94, 109, 201, 470, 774, 816, 822, 948, 1033, 1315, 1408, 1450, 1515, 1720, Conversation History]. You can find “tranquility of soul” by resting upon the "surest foundation," for if God has "magnified Your word above all Your name," His "everlasting dominion" is "secure" (Psalm 138:2; Daniel 7:14) [11, 24, 47, 92, 121, 176, 201, 266, 278, 352, 412, 602, 614, 1132, 1143, 1312, 1408, 1420, 1450, 1515, 1720, Conversation History].

***

**Final Reminder**
“ ‘Nevertheless the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who names the name of the Lord is to abstain from wickedness” ’ ” (2 Timothy 2:19). [11, 147, 176, 201, 211, 222, 285, 300, 303, 324, 332, 361, 405, 414, 444, 449, 591, 1138, 1441, 1450, Conversation History].
